title: ID0473856-DC/Si-D/PT-[Y2 / T2 314131339002] MGS5 not charging
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
MGS5 test in Alfragide. Customer reported in the beginning of the year that he couldn't charge in A2
Solution: MGS5 is declared to be charging fine in both chargers in Alfragide, whether in v8.1.4 or v4.0.11 - as such, this is declared as a isolated occurrence.

additional_info.subject: ID0473856-DC/Si-D/PT-[Y2 / T2 314131339002] MGS5 not charging CRM:02681001437
additional_info.body:
Hi Pedro,
I created the ticket in order to keep everything documented.
On the 3rd January, a customer complained that in A2, he couldn't charge with his MGS5 car.
Today we performed a charging test in 2 different chargers in Alfragide in different versions, v8.1.4 (same as the one in A2) and v4.0.11, in which both of them we had a successfull session, with no problems whatsoever.
I collected the EcoG logs and I am adding as attachment for documentation.
As aligned with you, we will not chase this customer and you send an email to the CPO mentioning that MGS5 is working, in order to prove that it must be a isolated occurrence.
As such, I will proceed to close the ticket.
BR,
Francisco
